correctness.rationale: Module-centralizer coordinates yield nilpotence iff both block constants vanish, exactly four commutator relations, and a free affine factor. An irreducible open rank-one stratum plus the closed linear b=c=0 stratum establishes the sharp m=3 component threshold; count of rank-one pairs yields the finite-field formula. Dense-matrix computations independently check cases n=5,6 over F2 and five-coordinate pair cases over F2,F3.
